impressions.text: The domain is agentic software-delivery tooling: merged PR #191 (10 files, +234/−5, 2026-10-19) implemented issue #189's rule that an issue card's Model is the open-task default and a different family requires an explicit --model-override with a written reason posted on the issue.

The first worker model (luna) stopped twice — first with a QUESTION asking where to persist the opening override's `why` since open-task creates no model-log segment, then a self-declared DESIGN stop with work remaining — leading to the orchestrator's mid-task switch to glm-flash.

The orchestrator answered the worker's flagged spec gap by specifying persistence in the PR body's hidden vmethod-task marker (modelOverride.from/to/reason), read by worker start as the first segment's `why: override: <reason>`.

glm-flash's strengths were one-round, evidence-dense delivery: it returned READY with tests for the refusal message, empty/whitespace reasons, the override NOTE-to-marker path, malformed-marker failures, and unchanged matching/absent --model cases, plus 1321 passing tests and green local and CI checks, reporting no deviations from the spec or ANSWER.

Telemetry is only partly recorded: the record lists no round causes, stalls, prompt defects or findings and marks the glm-flash segment's why as 'unrecorded' despite the posted switch NOTE, with the $0.097410 graded estimate and USD total recorded on issue #189.
